name: Profile Card
summary: Phone-first link-in-bio and digital business card: a softly moving colour cover, photo with an animated ring, name and one-line role, Call / Text / Email / Directions buttons, a Save contact button that downloads a real .vcf, big tappable link rows, a swipeable four-photo strip, hours and address with directions, and a Save bar that slides up after scrolling. On a computer it is a phone-width card floating over the moving shapes.

sections.name: profile
sections.what: Cover with a city chip and Share button, photo with animated ring, {{business}} as the h1, {{tagline}} as the role line, four quick actions (Call, Text, Email, Directions) and the Save contact button
sections.edit: Keep every token. Rewrite only if the owner wants a different role line; keep one h1. Do not add a fifth action; the row is sized for four

sections.name: links
sections.what: Large tappable rows with an icon, a title and a short line (the first one is highlighted in the accent colour)
sections.edit: One row per real service or link (3 to 7). hrefs must be tokens ({{email_href}}?subject=..., {{phone_href}}), #gallery / #visit, or real URLs the owner gave (website, booking page, social profile). Never href="#". Swap icons with inline svg from studio_icons

sections.name: gallery
sections.what: Swipeable strip of four photos with arrow buttons and dots
sections.edit: Use real photos. To show fewer, delete a whole figure and one dot span. Remove the section if there are no photos

sections.name: visit
sections.what: Small drawn map, hours (app.js turns 'Mon-Fri 8-6, Sat 9-3' into rows), address, Get directions and Copy address
sections.edit: Keep the tokens. Remove the hours row if the owner works by appointment only; remove the section if there is no address

sections.name: footer
sections.what: Name, year, city, back to top

photo_slots.hint: a friendly head-and-shoulders photo of the owner, or the logo on a plain background; face near the top third
the best example of the owner's work or product, 4:5 crop
another example of the work, a detail or the place
the owner at work, or a happy finished result
the shop, studio or a behind-the-scenes shot

behaviors: Save contact builds a .vcf from what the page shows (name, role, phone, email, address, hours and the photo) and downloads it with Blob + a download link
Text button becomes an sms: link from the phone token; Directions opens Google Maps with the address encoded
Share uses the phone's share sheet, or copies the link with a toast
hours text split into neat day / time rows
scroll-snap photo strip with arrows, dots and keyboard arrows
Save bar slides up from the bottom once the main Save button is scrolled away
slowly drifting colour shapes, dot grid and grain in the background (still for reduced motion)
avatar shape follows the style: round for soft styles, rounded or square for sharp ones
style_notes: Owns the single-column card archetype; every colour, font, radius and shadow comes from the style kit, so hard-shadow styles get brutalist rows and soft styles get pills and circles. Tested with editorial-serif, midnight-neon, neo-brutalist, poster-bold, soft-pastel, minimal-mono and dark-luxury at 390 and 1280. Best with soft-pastel, midnight-neon, coastal, warm-hospitality, clinical-clean, neo-brutalist.
